headline: Asia Stocks Rally Following SK Hynix Earnings and Ahead of Fed Decision
summary: Asian equity markets rallied as strong earnings from SK Hynix reinforced optimism surrounding the artificial intelligence sector, while investors braced for an upcoming Federal Reserve rate decision.
why: Regional tech earnings heavily influence broader Asian equity sentiment, acting as a proxy for global semiconductor demand cycles.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Robust memory chip earnings validate sustained corporate spending on artificial intelligence hardware infrastructure.

why_moved: Strong corporate earnings from key memory manufacturers combined with macro policy anticipation drive broad risk-on positioning across Asian indices.
